svg.title: Return current under a microstrip: DC, RF, and RF over a slot
svg.desc: Top views of a ground plane under a trace. At DC the return current spreads across the plane along wide arcs. At RF it runs in a narrow band directly under the trace. A slot cut across the plane forces the RF return current to detour around it, opening a large loop.
svg.text: Return current in the ground plane (top view, looking down through the board)
Simplified: plane drawn finite and not to scale. Red = return current in the plane, blue = signal current in the trace.
